8. As can be seen, PW-1 Rafiq, PW-2 Mohd. Parvez, PW-3 Sahid Khan, PW-4 Azim and PW-5 Masood Alam, have neither supported the case of the prosecution nor have assigned any criminal role to the accused person and have not deposed anything incriminating against him. Further, they also failed to identify the accused in the Court. No other witnesses have been examined by the prosecution to prove its case. In the circumstances, the prosecution evidence stands closed,
declining the request of Ld. Additional Public Prosecutor for leading further evidence, as it shall be futile to record the testimonies of other witnesses, who are formal or official in nature. The precious Court time should not be wasted in recording the evidence of formal or official witnesses when the prosecution witnesses, i.e. PW1, PW2, PW3, PW4 and PW5 have not supported the case of the prosecution. The statement under section 313 of the Cr.P.C of accused Monu @Tanvir is dispensed with as there is nothing incriminating against him.
